issues.title: Jordan Transport Authority Tightens App-Based Taxi Oversight
issues.title_en: Jordan Transport Authority Tightens App-Based Taxi Oversight
issues.summary: The Land Transport Regulatory Authority held an executive meeting on Saturday with representatives of licensed smart application companies operating in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, including Uber, Careem, Jeeny, Petra Ride, Gojo, Taxi F and CAB, to discuss activity regulation and oversight and agree on measures to strengthen compliance with operational requirements in the coming period.
